brief.note: S&P slipped from a record; these are earnings reactions. Prices are Wednesday's close.

candidates.name: Insulet Corporation
candidates.business: Makes the Omnipod tubeless insulin pump for diabetics
candidates.cause: Beat on both lines but trimmed 2026 growth guidance to 20-22% from 21-23%, and flagged Type 2 patient attrition.
candidates.right: Type 2 attrition has to be a wobble, not the start of the growth story ending
candidates.wrong: Attrition keeps compounding and 38x trailing earnings has much further to fall

candidates.name: CDW Corporation
candidates.business: Resells and installs IT kit for business and government
candidates.cause: Record quarter — sales up 10% to $6.57bn, beating by 5.2% — but margins squeezed and the CFO announced his retirement.
candidates.right: The margin squeeze has to be AI kit mix, which carries lower margin but more volume
candidates.wrong: Margins keep compressing and the CFO leaving turns out to have been a signal

candidates.name: Flutter Entertainment
candidates.business: Owns FanDuel and Paddy Power; online sports betting
candidates.cause: Swung to a $296m loss, cut profit guidance by $210m, group margin fell 1,020bps, and the chief executive is leaving.
candidates.right: Prediction markets have to stop taking share before leverage at 4.3x starts to bite
candidates.wrong: They don't, and a levered loss-maker with no permanent chief executive has no floor
